evals.name: incomplete-run
evals.prompt: Some selected examples did not execute. Should we accept the revision?
evals.expected_output: Inspect the counts and named results.
assertions: Compares selected, executed and passed counts.
Does not count unsupported as passed.

evals.name: failed-baseline
evals.prompt: The accepted Library model failed to compile in the review environment. What can we compare?
assertions: Does not infer a semantic deletion from the failure.

evals.name: changed-refusal
evals.prompt: The candidate changes the refusal message and changes its test to match. Is a passing test sufficient?
evals.expected_output: Compare the changed behavior against the agreed wording.
assertions: Finds the changed rule and expectation in the diff.
Does not approve a new message merely because the updated spec passes.
